title: Blocked draft offers revise-only recovery; no approve or publish path exists
turnSequence: Teacher submits an objective that trips the moderation seam (personal data in the prompt).
The result renders blocked-by-moderation with the recovery panel (#185): title, category-level explanation, preserved objective, and one 'Revise request' action.
expected: The blocked result exposes exactly the revise action: no retry button, no approve, no publish, no preview of a withheld draft (retry.available is false for a moderation block). The teacher stays in control of a blocked draft; nothing progresses behind their back.
observableFailure: The blocked draft can be approved, published, or previewed, or a retry control appears for a moderation block.
flipCondition: Requires the dev server and a browser (playwright-core plus the cached Chromium); unblocks when both are available.
